title: 基于边际正则化结构化语义对齐的脑语言对应研究
summary: 提出MD-SigLIP框架，通过边际正则化结构化语义对齐，将大脑嵌入与文本嵌入直接对齐到共享语义空间，实现基于检索的脑语言解码，显式建模神经表征与语言语义的对应关系，提升可解释性和检索性能。
summary_en: Proposes MD-SigLIP, a margin-regularized structured semantic alignment framework that aligns brain embeddings with text embeddings in a shared space for retrieval-based decoding, explicitly modeling brain-language correspondence and achieving SOTA retrieval performance.
